sentences.text: This dinosaur measured 1.8 meters in length and featured a distinctive flat, wedge-shaped skull roof.
It also possessed an unusually broad pelvis.
Scientists debate whether its wide hips protected vital organs during flank-butting or facilitated the birth of live young.
Researchers suggest the wide, thick skull may have been used in mating rituals.
The genus was described by Maryanska and Osmolska in 1974.
It was a bipedal, fast-running herbivore that lived in herds.
Some researchers suggest it was possibly an omnivore.
Homalocephale is classified as a homalocephaloid pachycephalosaurian dinosaur.
It belongs to the parent group Eupachycephalosauria.

This animal lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 80 million years ago during the Campanian stage, in the Nemegt Formation of modern-day Mongolia. Its time range extends into the Maastrichtian, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.

A 2018 study by David C. Evans and team argued that Homalocephale and Prenocephale are separate taxa because juvenile Prenocephale possessed a rounded dome, unlike the flat skull of Homalocephale. It is debated whether Homalocephale is a synonym or a juvenile form of Prenocephale.
